items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: I remember Jim Robinson was almost always in the band

ctx.x: They probably played eight or ten pieces in those bands, and, you know, ten.
And, you know, John Casimir was always there, and I remember Jim Robinson was almost always in the band, and Wilbur Tillman was always, almost always in it.

I was just thinking, at a big Sunday school parade, they might have had some bands. You know, they had so many bands, they might have had some bands that would jump up bands, as they called them. Yeah.
